notes: Shopify storefront (robots.txt self-identifies 'Shopify storefront'; no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai disallow found). www.fenwick.co.uk redirects to canonical fenwick.co.uk, used in all links. Direct fetch worked throughout, no WAF/Akamai blocking encountered (unlike other department-store platforms in this project) despite the roster note flagging that risk. Fenwick is a multi-department store (fashion, beauty, food, tech, furniture); the relevant Home Decor content lives entirely under the 'Home & Tech' mega-menu department, reached via /collections/home-and-tech-* handles. Full nav tree captured from the rendered homepage mega-menu (400 links). Counts verified by exhaustive pagination of each collection's /products.json (limit=250) counting unique Shopify product IDs to exhaustion (last page <250 items) -- this is an exact catalogue count, not the (separately known-inflated) collections.json products_count field. Excluded per scope rules: Electricals, Kitchen (cookware/bakeware/utensils/food storage/textiles), Bedroom (Bed Linen/Pillows/Duvets/Mattress Toppers -- pure textiles/bedding), Bathroom (Towels/Bathmats -- textiles), Games & Stationery, The Bookshop, Reading Glasses (a filtered search link, not a real collection), Home Fragrance & Candles (spot-checked 30 titles: 100% scented candles/diffusers/room sprays/reed diffusers, no unscented sub-listing exists), Throws & Blankets and Cushions & Textiles (textiles). Dropped as mixed roll-ups with no clean decorative-only split (per 'mixed roll-ups: drop, don't pad'): 'Tableware & Cutlery' (663 items -- sampled titles show dinner plates/bowls/platters genuinely in scope mixed inseparably with cutlery sets, pepper/spice mills, placemats and napkins, no sub-collection isolates just the tableware); 'Bedroom Accessories' (32 items -- 100% textiles: cushions, throws, hot water bottle covers, laundry baskets, bedcovers, no decor items found); 'Bathroom Accessories' (41 items -- dominated by bathroom hardware/plumbing accessories per Rule 0.4 exclusion (soap dispensers, toilet brush/roll holders, bins) plus silk sleep accessories; a handful of standalone bathroom mirrors (Suction Cup Mirror, Toiletpaper Mirror, 5x Magnifying Mirror) were spotted inside this junk-drawer collection but cannot be isolated to an exact count -- the dedicated Mirrors collection (74 items, includes Toiletpaper Lipsticks/Snakes mirrors) already covers the mirror type generally, so this room-accessories node is dropped rather than padded). Checked Furniture & Outdoor department nav for any outdoor lighting/mirror room-branch (Rule 0.5) -- none exists; that department is 100% furniture (sofas, tables, wardrobes, garden furniture), no lighting or decor sub-nodes, so nothing extractable there. Rule 0 application: 'Bedroom' and 'Bathroom' top-level room nodes were opened and inspected on product-type merits per Rule 0.4/0.5 rather than skipped on the room name alone; both were genuinely non-decor once inspected, which is a real (not assumed) exclusion. Site presents one flat type-based tree under Home & Tech (no separate room-based Lighting/Mirrors sub-nav), so no Rule 0.6 overlap to document.
